lesson.title: Quantum Curiosity
lesson.topic: Exploring how quantum mechanics challenges our classical understanding of reality and encourages a sense of wonder.
lesson.steelman: How can the principles of quantum mechanics, like superposition and entanglement, be used to rethink common assumptions about technology and society?
lesson.example: Discussion on Schrödinger's cat thought experiment as a gateway to deeper philosophical questions about observation and reality in digital contexts.

rationale: This lesson bridges scientific inquiry with existential curiosity, vital for fostering an open-minded approach to both physical sciences and digital sovereignty.
